paragraphs.html: Note on this draft. This is the third iteration of the chapter. It contains only material checked page by page against the sources already in hand. More will be added once Bonola (1912), Cogliati (2012) and Trudeau (2001) have been studied: the Schweikart–Taurinus episode, Poincaré’s route to his models via Fuchsian functions, and the closing philosophical discussion of the chapter.
